title: Why New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani wants 15% of whatever NYU’s new quantum lab invents
content: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has committed $29.2 million to NYU's Quantum Fabrication Facility (QFab) in Manhattan, set to open in 2030. In return, the city gets 15% of NYU's proceeds from intellectual property created with city-funded tools, plus three advisory board seats. Backed by $284 million in total funding, the new quantum lab will train CUNY students and support more than 100 companies.

title: Meet Gabriella Rothberg, 17, co-inventor of patented genetically engineered tomato
content: A sandwich idea at 15 led Miami student Gabriella Rothberg to develop genetically engineered tomatoes designed to produce heme, an iron-containing molecule associated with meat flavour. Now 17, she is listed alongside her father on a US patent issued in June 2026. The project remains experimental, with taste and nutritional benefits yet to be established.

title: US temple attack plot: Teen’s alleged manifesto describes Indians as ‘subhumans’
content: A 19-year-old white supremacist's intention to attack a temple near Chicago was disrupted by a rifle malfunction. Following the incident, concerned colleagues notified authorities after he expressed his intentions via messages. Police arrested Alexandros Paporakis, uncovering alarming materials including a manifesto that targeted several communities. The case has raised serious safety concerns among Hindu organizations about worship places.

title: Elvis Presley bought Beverly Hills home for $400,000; it later sold for $25.5m
content: In 1967, Elvis and Priscilla Presley acquired an opulent home in Beverly Hills' Trousdale Estates for $400,000. Their tenure at the estate lasted until 1973, marking the period when their daughter Lisa Marie was born. After significant renovations, the property was sold in 2019 for an impressive $25.5 million, showcasing the lasting allure of celebrity residences and the historic value they carry.

title: Michael Douglas keeps 190-acre Mallorca estate 36 years after buying it
content: Michael Douglas and Catherine Zeta-Jones enjoy their historic estate, S'Estaca, located in Mallorca. The property, set on 190 acres, features multiple buildings and stunning views of the Mediterranean Sea. Douglas originally purchased the estate in 1990 with his first wife, Diandra Luker, and they later became the sole owners. The couple has created cherished family memories there, raising their two children while entertaining numerous famous guests.

title: Michael Dell loses $20 billion in one day after Barclays downgrade
content: Michael Dell experienced a substantial decline in net worth, dropping more than $20 billion in just one day. This decline was prompted by a major decrease in his company's stock value following an analyst downgrade. Earlier this year, Dell's net worth had notably increased, bringing him closer to the highest billionaires in the world.

title: No more guessing who's calling! Govt mandates caller ID display from Nov 1
content: The Department of Telecommunications is preparing to roll out Calling Name Presentation, a feature that shows the caller's name in addition to their number on the recipient's screen. This functionality will first be implemented on 4G networks before extending to other versions. Users will have the choice to opt-out if they utilize the calling line identification restriction service, striking a balance between enhancing caller recognition and safeguarding data privacy.

title: Ex-IAS Divya launches party: 10 civil servants who quit service to enter politics
content: Divya Mittal, an ex-IAS officer, has established the Jan Neeti Bharat party in preparation for the forthcoming elections. With a focus on enhancing citizen participation in policymaking rather than adhering to conventional governance methods, she aims to make a significant impact. Her decision to retire after 13 years in civil service aligns with a trend of bureaucrats entering politics.

title: 6,000 cops, 200 CAPF companies, 21 roads facing curbs: Delhi gears up for CJP march
content: Central Delhi is preparing for a significant security operation ahead of the Cockroach Janta Party's proposed march. The Delhi Police will deploy around 6,000 personnel and implement traffic restrictions in the area. The Central Park at Connaught Place is set to remain closed, impacting the proposed gathering. Authorities have denotified Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site, redirecting protests to alternative venues.

title: From Ambani to Zelenskyy, Musk mixes business with politics
content: Elon Musk is increasingly acting as an influential figure in global politics and domestic affairs. His recent remarks about Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reflect attempts to sway leadership in Ukraine. Musk's substantial financial contributions to American politics emphasize his growing influence over legislative decisions. His disputes with India regarding Starlink highlight the intersection of business interests and political power.

title: 'Will stand with Pak if US attacks': Rajasthan BJP chief’s remark sparks outcry
content: Rajasthan BJP president Madan Rathore stated that India would align with Pakistan in a potential US-Pakistan conflict. This statement has drawn significant criticism from Congress leaders, including Shama Mohamed. Mohamed questioned the BJP's stance and asked for clarification from Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Amit Shah. Rathore also accused Rahul Gandhi of inciting unrest and mentioned foreign interference in India's stability.

title: Imran Khan asked to leave India: What rights do OCI cardholders have?
content: Actor Imran Khan faces deportation from India by October 28 due to his involvement in a protest. This action stems from a complaint lodged by BJP leader Kirit Somaiya regarding legal violations during the demonstration. Khan, a US citizen and OCI cardholder, was detained at the protest site in Mumbai. His participation raises questions about the rights of foreign nationals involved in political activities.

title: Brazil plants 840,000 trees to restore 607 hectares of Atlantic Forest
content: Brazil's Atlantic Forest is undergoing remarkable restoration efforts, spearheaded by World Land Trust and Reserva Ecológica de Guapiaçu. With 840,000 trees planted over 20 years, 607 hectares of degraded land have been revived into verdant forest. This initiative has created a vital wildlife corridor, facilitating the return of over 220 bird species to the previous wetland, while striving to protect and enhance the Guapiaçu watershed's remaining forest.

title: Yemen claims over 700 Houthis killed after 1,250 strikes rained within 24 hours
content: Yemen armed forces reported conducting 1,250 targeting operations against Houthis in one day. These strikes coincided with Houthi attacks on Aden’s presidential palace, resulting in casualties. Houthi spokesperson denied claims of missile strikes towards Medina, asserting their innocence. Meanwhile, the Saudi-led coalition intercepted several missiles aimed at its territories amid ongoing tensions. Overall, hostilities between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia have intensified over recent months.

title: ‘Collapse could be precipitous’: Super El Niño could push coral reefs to extinction
content: Researchers warn that the ongoing super El Niño could further endanger already vulnerable coral species. The rise in ocean temperatures has led to record coral bleaching events which have severe consequences for coral health. Nearly half of coral species were at increased risk of extinction by 2020 due to climate change effects. Future coral assessments may reveal even more alarming data regarding extinction risks among coral species.

title: India’s current account deficit narrows to $5.2 billion in August, RBI data shows
content: India's overall balance of payments showed a surplus of $45.4 billion in August 2026. This significant surplus is attributed to an increase in foreign currency inflows, especially from non-resident Indian deposits. The current account deficit also narrowed slightly to $5.2 billion during the same month. Foreign direct investment improved, with net inflows of $3.3 billion recorded.

title: Flat redeveloped, man sells in 8 days for Rs 1.95 cr; gets notice, ITAT gives relief
content: The man had purchased a 510-square-foot flat in a housing society in Mumbai, during FY 2006-07, where he lived with his wife. title: Mumbai shocker: CCTV clip shows 10-year-old pushing 18-month-old off 6th floor duct

The incident occurred while toddler was playing in the corridor of her housing society. After finding her injured, residents rushed her to a doctor, but she was declared dead.

title: 'Skipped dinner, wept': 'Blue drum' murder convicts' 1st night in jail

They were convicted for the brutal murder of Muskan's husband, Saurabh Rajput, earlier this year. The court described the murder as extremely cruel and grave, leading to their sentencing. Muskan is allowed to keep her infant daughter Radha with her while seeking permission to meet her elder daughter, Pihu.

title: Andhra Pradesh shocker: Lover lured to pond, beaten to death; husband, wife arrested

External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar also indicated that progress ensures a positive outcome is imminent.

title: 'Ready for it': Dipke claims police may detain him today
content: dipke questioned the decision to shut the park, saying the authorities could not close every location where the outfit might organise a demonstration . he said police personnel were keeping him under surveillance and said he could be detained overnight or on Friday morning . dipke was prepared to go to jail for waving the Tricolour as the outfit called on supporters to gather at Central Park on Friday .

title: Migrants taking four in five new jobs in Britain; Indians largest foreign workforce
content: just one in five (734,000) of the 3.7 million additional payroll jobs created in Britain between 2014 and 2025 went to British nationals, a report by the centre for social justice reveals . a think tank studies the root causes of Britain’s social problems found that EU nationals accounted for 408,000 of these jobs . those held by non-EU nationals increased by 2.5 million .

title: Panel seeks citizens' inputs on 'unnatural' demographic shifts
content: the high-level committee has sought individual citizens' inputs on major demographic changes . individual responders can provide causes of demographic changes, as perceived by them . they have been further told to specify the challenges arising due to demographic change .

title: US: 3 children, 1 adult killed in shooting at Oregon elementary school
content: the suspect was shot and killed inside the school, police say . multiple victims were children, according to a police spokesperson . the suspect is dead, but it is not immediately clear who had shot the suspect . police received a 911 call reporting an unknown man fired a shot into a car outside the school .

title: White House prepares plans to use 'mother of all bombs' on Iran: Report
content: the plans include the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast (MOAB), commonly known as the “mother of all bombs”, which weighs more than 21,000 pounds . potential targets included energy infrastructure and the suspected nuclear facility at Pickaxe Mountain .

title: We are not in an ivory tower & can’t be browbeaten: CJI on oppn plea challenging SIR
content: a petition filed by inDIA bloc functionaries led by Rahul Gandhi alleges irregularities in SIR, arbitrary deletion of voters, undemocratic functioning of the poll panel and flaws in EVM use . a bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi said it was issuing notices on the petition and would await the responses .
